description: Request a search of the DPMA and EUIPO trademark registers for identical and similar marks to a name. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 10–40 per name.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

goods_services.description: What the name is used for, or Nice classes.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

name.description: Name or word mark to check.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
